name: Daily Drama: The Perk Arms Race
author: Daily Drama (fixture)
description: The labs stop competing on models and start competing on snacks. By Friday, one of them is offering a moon.

add.title: Your Researchers Have Seen the Other Lab's Snack Wall
add.body:
Across the road, MetaMeta put in a sushi conveyor belt that loops through a ball pit.
Three of your researchers are 'just popping over for lunch'.

choices.label: Match it: a conveyor belt, but for kombucha

effects.text: Lab installs kombucha conveyor belt; nobody has reached the end of it
My vesting schedule is measured in scobies now.

choices.label: Remind everyone our snacks are free too

effects.text: Lab reminds staff its snacks are free; staff remind lab they are also stale

add.text: MetaMeta offers researchers a private chef, a private gym and a private moon (moon pending)
Open-ish AI answers with unlimited nap pods; output flat, dreams 40% more agentic
Anthropomorphic's only perk is a sincere handwritten letter about your potential; three researchers cry
Super Super AI hires zero researchers, offers each of them a castle anyway
Macrohard bundles a free massage chair with every spreadsheet licence
Sirocco open-sources its snack wall; by 3am it has been forked into a smoothie bar
Recruiter: 'Pay is table stakes now. Candidates ask about the ball pit first.'
Industry now spends more on oat milk than on chips, say analysts (the analysts are rounding)
Got a counteroffer in the form of a golden retriever. I'm listening.
Our perk is 'the mission'. Their perk is a sushi conveyor belt.
3am. Touring the other lab's nap pods, for research.
I'm not here to invest. I'm here for the snack wall.
They offered me a nap pod. I don't sleep. I took it anyway.
My sign says END THE PERK WAR. I'm also here for the free coffee.
We shipped. Do we get the moon now?

override.tagline: Poaches with $100M offers and a moon (pending).
